notes.title: Update: A More Shiny Penguin Experience...
notes.notes:
Streamer [b]Olivia_Winter[/b] posted a [b]full playthrough[/b] of Penguin Panic! I recommend watching it, because it reveals a lot of secrets... While this is awesome, Olivia also managed to find some glitches. We've patched them all, to give you an even more seamless experience. 

While we were at it, we replaced the Level Select music by something new. Penguins like it. This wasn't tested, but it's almost certain. We've been absolutely thrilled by the reception so far. Seeing people race for the leaderboards makes us flap our penguin wings in excitement. Enjoy!

[previewyoutube=kRfjpEPOXK4;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Penguin Panic Release!
notes.notes:
As you know, penguins are not the fastest birds in the world. But finally we now have a release date: Monday, 21st of April.

On that day, Penguin Panic will go out of Early Access and you will be able to enjoy the full game.

A lot of extra content and features have been added. So stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45126967/c5d458bc2a405487002ad4653e9403fc1d2ff865.png[/img]

notes.title: Final Release of Penguin Panic coming up!
notes.notes:
[b]Final release is coming up![/b]

We have been working really hard on the release of Penguin Panic for PC, Mac and Steam Deck. With your input, we've made plenty of improvements and added a lot of new content.

So, what can you expect?
[olist]
[*] 5 new side levels
[*] 2 underwater levels
[*] 1 super hard level that was created by a 9-year old
[*] more dancing penguins!
[*] more surprises when you find an egg
[*] a jukebox to play all the music in the game
[*] achievements
[*] leaderboards
[*] improved camera handling for better playability
[*] full controller support
[*] new balancing of fish needed to unlock levels
[/olist]

Penguin Panic has grown from a fun but rather limited game into a content-rich experience. Still fun and not complicated, but more memorable and with more overall gameplay.

We'll need a few more days to iron out all the bugs and then we can all enjoy this new penguin experience.

Noot noot!
